contract: A2UI v0.8 extensions are expressed via custom/inline catalogs negotiated at beginRendering.catalogId + client a2uiClientCapabilities.inlineCatalogs. An unknown component type MUST be preserved verbatim together with its catalog reference; the adapter records the inline catalog dependency and emits a warning, never discarding the extension. The drift harness (1-7-4-4) treats field deletion / dropped extension as semantic loss (hard fail) and version/catalog drift as report-only.
capture_method: spec-conformant; modeled on the v0.8 inline-catalog negotiation example (a2ui.org/specification/v0.8-a2ui/). No runtime execution.
